blob.description: The content key of the bytes these rows describe

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed, each under one fixed synthetic file name: `ts` (`.ts`, `.mts`, `.cts`, not a declaration file) as `vat.ts`, ScriptKind TS; `dts` (every name TypeScript's isDeclarationFileName accepts) as `vat.d.ts`, ScriptKind TS; `tsx` (`.tsx`) as `vat.tsx`, ScriptKind TSX; `js` (`.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`) as `vat.js`, ScriptKind JS

seq.description: 0-based position among the file's exports, in source order

name.description: The exported name, or null for `export *` and for `assignment` (`export =`, `module.exports =`), which replace the whole module and name no export

kind.description: The export form: `declaration` an `export` modifier (`export default function f` included); `local` `export { a as b }` or `export default ident`; `expression` `export default <other>`; `reexport` `export { a as b } from`; `star` `export * from`; `namespace` `export * as ns from`; `assignment` `export =` or `module.exports =`; `cjs` `exports.x =` or `module.exports.x =`; `globalNamespace` `export as namespace X`; `importAlias` `export import a = N.b`

local.description: The local name exported, or null when the form names none

imported.description: The source module's name for `reexport`, else null

import.description: The `ts__imports` ordinal of the module reference for `reexport`, `star` and `namespace`, else null

typeOnly.description: Whether the export is type-only, at statement level or by an inline `type`

line.description: 1-based line, over the decoded text (BOM stripped); CR, LF and CRLF each one break; at the exported name token (the module specifier for `star`, the expression for `assignment`)
